findings.current: For more than thirty years, the Doppelganger had enjoyed a freedom it had never known before.
findings.defect: The Korean says it was freer than ever during those years, not that it had never known freedom before. The English makes a stronger claim about its past.
findings.rationale: 그 어느 때보다 자유로웠고 compares its freedom with any time before; it does not say the Doppelganger had never previously been free.
findings.replacement: For more than thirty years, the Doppelganger had been freer than ever.

findings.current: the rare few born to wield absolute power
findings.defect: This changes beings born with the fate of an absolute being into beings born to wield absolute power. The source does not specify wielding power as their destiny.
findings.rationale: 절대자의 운명을 타고난 describes beings born with the fate of an absolute being, rather than explicitly saying they are destined to wield power.
findings.replacement: the rare few born to become absolute beings

summary: Two minor additions shift the source’s comparison of the Doppelganger’s freedom and the nature of the exceptional beings.
